brand.name: Ember Grace Church
brand.descriptor: Hope in the heart of Leeds

hero.title: A warm place to find faith, friends and a way forward.
hero.body: We are a modern Christian church in Leeds, learning to follow Jesus with honesty, kindness and hope.
hero.imageAlt: Modern church congregation worshipping in warm morning light

sundays.title: What Sundays feel like
sundays.body: Coffee first, worship together, a thoughtful message, kids groups, and plenty of space to ask questions.

groups.title: Belong during the week
groups.body: Small groups meet across the city for food, prayer, scripture and practical care.
groups.imageAlt: Church welcome team greeting visitors over coffee

visit.title: You can just turn up.
visit.body: No church background needed. Come as you are and someone friendly will help you find your way.
visit.messageLabel: What would help you feel welcome?
visit.button: Let us know you are coming

safeguarding.title: Safeguarding
safeguarding.body: We are committed to creating a safe church for children, young people and vulnerable adults. Edit this page with your policy contact and procedures.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: We use personal details only for church communication, pastoral follow-up and the activities people choose to join.
